pages.text: Altered from $(c)Curse Of Vanishing$(), $(4)Denial$() will kill the user when the equipment is about to break, repairing it slightly. Maximum level is $(4)I$() and it conflicts with $(c)Curse of Vanishing$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: If the user has a history of accidentally breaking their tools, this can be a sure-fire way to stop that from happening... assuming the tool is worth the user's life.
